 LIVE UPDATES NBA New York Knicks vs. Indiana Pacers Live NBA Updates, Scores and Highlights
 Dan Favale Nov 13, 2026, updated 4 min ago 
 The New York Knicks and Indiana Pacers are both looking for their first win of the 2026 NBA Cup on Friday night. One of them will leave Gainbridge Fieldhouse with a victory and chance to make it through to the knockout stage. The other will see their odds all but scuttled.
 Indiana enters coming off a victory over the Washington Wizards on Wednesday night yet remains without superstar Tyrese Haliburton and has dropped seven of its last nine games. New York is fresh off a loss to the Cleveland Cavaliers, but has won six of eight.
 Which squad will get the highly coveted, if not necessary, W on Friday? Find out below by following all the latest updates, highlights, analysis and takeaways.
 Live Updates
 21 Total Posts
 Newest First ​ Just Now 07:29 PM Indy's Bench is Getting It Done
 Bench play has been another huge factor in this one. The Pacers' reserves have outscored the Knicks' second-stringers 22-6.
 10 mins ago 07:23 PM The Knicks are Lucky to Only Be Down Nine
 Contrary to what many currently believe, the whistles don't seem that egregious. But that free-throw discrepancy is real. 
 The three-point struggles loom larger, though. Landry Shamet, Miles McBride, OG Anunoby, Mikal Bridges and Josh Hart are a combined 2-of-13 (15.3 percent) from beyond the arc. 
 14 mins ago 07:18 PM Jarace Walker Out of the Pacers' Rotation?
 Well, this isn't a great look. Then again, when Jalen Slawson is grabbing every available rebound during his time on the floor, I get it.
 16 mins ago 07:16 PM Mike Brown is NOT Happy with the Refs
 Kudos to Mike Brown for only getting three techs over the past year-and-a-half. Perhaps it's just a coincidence, but the Knicks closed the quarter stronger after their head honcho went at the refs.
 Score: Pacers 58, Knicks 49 | Halftime 
 20 mins ago 07:13 PM Cross-Court Dime from T.J. McConnell
 MLB free agency is happening right now, in case any club is in the market for another pitcher.
 23 mins ago 07:10 PM Pacome Dadiet Update
 This has been your Pacome Dadiet update.
 25 mins ago 07:08 PM STOP WHAT YOU'RE DOING...
 ...we have a Pacome Dadiet sighting.
 Clearly, Mike Brown is looking for the third-year wing, who has played under 20 minutes on the season, to provide the offensive jolt New York is currently lacking.
 28 mins ago 07:05 PM These NBA Cup Courts are as Slippery as They Look
 The league needs to stop having arena crews coat these things in baby oil and spit, in my humble opinion.
 Oh, Indy has opened up a six-point lead with a strong second quarter. Jalen Slawson is dominating the glass, and the Pacers have attempted 10 free throws in the frame already (though they've only made six).
 Score: Pacers 44, Knicks 38 | 4:27 remaining in the second quarter 
 33 mins ago 06:59 PM Pascal Siakam Hit Basically Every Part of the Rim 😂
 The NBA Cup: where suspenseful first-half jump shots happen.
 36 mins ago 06:57 PM Karl-Anthony Towns Tweaked his Risk
 Hopefully, he's fine. In the meantime, can we turn injuries off already? 
 Please? 
 43 mins ago 06:50 PM 8 Points in 60 Seconds
 Not quite eight points in nine seconds, but nicely done anyway, Mr. Huff.
 44 mins ago 06:48 PM Tyler Kolek is Getting...Boards
 Maybe this is what it takes for the NYPD to recognize him.
 Score: Knick 31, Pacers 31 | 9:14 remaining in the second quarter 
 51 mins ago 06:42 PM Aaron Nesmith Put Josh Hart in a Blender
 This wasn't the cleanest looking move, but hey: If it works, it works.
 52 mins ago 06:41 PM Knicks Take a 1-Point Lead into the Second
 Karl-Anthony Towns continues to lead all scorers with 12 points. Jay Huff is, ahem, pacing the Pacers with eight. Putting T.J. McConnell in the game noticeably changed the speed at which Indy was executing its offense.
 Neither team is shooting well from deep. The Knicks are 3-of-14 while the Pacers are 3-of-11.
 Knicks 27, Pacers 26 | End of the first quarter 
 59 mins ago 06:34 PM Karl-Anthony Towns Continues to Dominate
 The Knicks' Twitter admin has a point.
 Karl-Anthony Towns leads all scorers with nine points. But both he and Jalen Brunson (two fouls) are currently on the bench, making this a huge stretch to close the first quarter for New York. Indiana is already back in front after a flurry from Jay Huff.
 Score: Pacers 24, Knicks 23 | 1:41 remaining in the first quarter 
 1 hour ago 06:28 PM Jay Huff is Carving Up the Knicks
 Jay Huff came in for Ivica Zubac at the first timeout. He's played barely two minutes.
 He already has eight points. 
 Score: Knicks 23, Pacers 22 | 3:49 remaining in the first quarter 
 1 hour ago 06:24 PM The Knicks Defense is Starting Active
 On top of this deflection and steal, New York has yet to give up an offensive rebound in the early going. 
 Knicks fans will also be ecstatic to know that Mikal Bridges is playing like his starting spot is on the line.
 1 hour ago 06:21 PM Rick Carlisle isn't Happy with the Pacers' Defense
 New York's ball and body movement has been pristine to start. The Knicks have six assists on seven made shots. 
 Score: Knicks 16, Pacers 9 | 7:39 remaining in the first quarter 
 1 hour ago 06:19 PM The Knicks Are Already Thinking About the Next Game
 We are underway here in Indy, but the Knicks have a game in Toronto on Saturday. Will they be able to take off tonight or tomorrow? 
 Sounds like that'll be up to the Federal Flight Administration.
 Score: Knicks 14, Pacers 9 | 8:02 remaining in the first quarter 
 1 hour ago 06:06 PM Aaron Nesmith will Start for the Pacers
 That means Indy's starting five will be Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard, Kelly Oubre Jr., Pascal Siakam and Ivica Zubac. 
 This group has played 22 minutes across two appearances together on the season. The Pacers have outscored their opponents by three points in that limited time.
 1 hour ago 05:59 PM No Starting Lineup Changes for the Knicks
 Anyone wondering whether Mike Brown would bench Mikal Bridges has their answer. The Knicks will roll out Jalen Brunson, Josh Hart, OG Anunoby, Karl-Anthony Towns and...Bridges.
